skillset.skill: 60s CT - 10000% Light DMG (Physical). If user is Light, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 20% for 15s. Additionally if used when own HP is above 80%, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by an additional 15%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Kingsoul Orvell, increase own DMG by 50%, and Freeze resistance and Paralysis resistance by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
